All five review fixes from the browser walk of the capture flow have been implemented:

1. **Answer persistence & Loss Notice display**:
   - In [capture.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/capture.html), aligned chip selection keys and DOM ids between `other_vehicle` and `other-vehicle`.
   - In [main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py), updated `/c/{token}/answers` and `/c/{token}/submit` to parse, normalize, and persist every step answer (`other_vehicle`, `police`, `drivable`) into `answers_json` and `claims`.
   - In [console_claim.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_claim.html), ensured each answer is shown in the Loss Notice.
   - Added `test_what_happened_step_answers_saved_and_shown_in_loss_notice` and `test_what_happened_hyphenated_other_vehicle_saved` in [test_capture_flow.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_capture_flow.py).

2. **Unmapped parts in `map_parts_to_claimed_area`**:
   - In [checks.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/checks.py), updated `map_parts_to_claimed_area` to return `None` when selected parts do not map to front/rear/left/right (e.g., only "Roof" or "Wheels or tires") rather than defaulting to `"rear"`.
   - In [main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py), updated answer persistence and claim submit so that when `map_parts_to_claimed_area` returns `None`, `claimed_damage_area` is set to `None`, causing `run_checks` to report the `damage_location` check as `unchecked`.
   - Added unit and flow tests in [test_checks.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_checks.py) and [test_capture_flow.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_capture_flow.py).

3. **Loss Notice formatting**:
   - In [console_claim.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_claim.html), updated empty optional answers to show "Not given" instead of "N/A".
   - In [main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py), added `format_readable_datetime` and `format_readable_time` to format "Signed at" and "Date of the loss" in server local time like `"Nov 14, 2026, 8:37 PM"` rather than raw ISO strings.
   - Added `test_loss_notice_empty_optional_answers_show_not_given_and_readable_dates` in [test_capture_flow.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_capture_flow.py).

   - Added `<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,...">` (blue rounded square `%232563eb` with a white shield `%23ffffff`) to [base.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/base.html), [capture.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/capture.html), [c_complete.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/c_complete.html), and [c_submitted.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/c_submitted.html).
